sections.content:
Hack Club, a global nonprofit organization, is seeking an exceptional, mission-driven Major Giving Lead to join our team and make a real impact on the lives of high school students around the world.
As our Major Giving Lead, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of education by growing a network of high net worth donors who share our vision. You'll be at the forefront of our fundraising efforts, connecting with a global community of philanthropists who are committed to supporting the next generation of creators, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs, leveraging your exceptional interpersonal skills to engage them through regular meetings and communication, and inspirational cultivation events. You'll be part of an organization that believes in the power of technology to unlock unlimited potential in young minds. With our school-based clubs, we provide students with the resources, mentorship, community, and real-world opportunities they need to thrive.
At Hack Club, we believe in investing in our team members' growth and professional development. You'll have access to a collaborative and supportive work environment, where your ideas and expertise will be valued. And you'll work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of young people and building a movement that empowers the next generation of innovators and leaders.

sections.heading: Responsibilities:
sections.content:
Develop and execute a comprehensive major gifts fundraising strategy that aligns with Hack Club’s mission and fundraising objectives.
Work with co-founders to identify, research and qualify potential major donors.
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with current and prospective major donors and high net worth individuals through regular communications and meetings, donor-focused events, and on-going stewardship.
Create compelling proposals and presentations that effectively communicate Hack Club’s impact and the value of major donor support.
Collaborate with board members, staff and volunteers to engage major donors in fundraising efforts and develop donor stewardship plans.
Ensure timely and personalized stewardship of major donors, including regular communication, recognition, and impact reporting.
Work with Digital Fundraising Manager to maintain accurate and up-to-date donor records in the organization's CRM database and provide regular reports on major donor fundraising activities to the co-founders.
Represent Hack Club at relevant fundraising events, community gatherings, and donor cultivation activities to expand the organization's network and visibility.

sections.heading: Qualifications:
sections.content:
A minimum of 5 years of experience in nonprofit fundraising, with a demonstrated track record of success in major gifts fundraising.
Experience at a direct service organization, preferably an organization that is focused on youth development or technology-based training
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with high net worth individuals.
Proven ability to develop and implement effective major gifts fundraising strategies.
Experience working with CRM databases and fundraising tools for donor management and prospect research.
In-depth knowledge of fundraising best practices and trends in major gifts fundraising within the nonprofit sector.
Strong organizational and project management abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Self-motivated and able to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A passion for education, technology, and empowering young people.

sections.heading: Location:
sections.content: The Major Giving Lead is a remote position, with preference given to candidates who live in Vermont. The Lead is expected to travel to various cities across the United States for donor meetings and cultivation events.

sections.heading: Benefits:
sections.content:
Health, dental, and vision packages
4 weeks of PTO (including 1 week during the week of Christmas)
11 additional paid holidays
$2,000 hardware stipend (enough for a MacBook Air, big monitor, etc

sections.heading: Hack Club is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
Deadline:
sections.content: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
